procedure: Settings copied from the GPQA Sonnet verification study (configs/gpqa_sonnet55_verification_20261016.json).
For each held-out fold k and each loss: fit per-verifier likelihoods, costs and the triple order on the other four folds only, separately per generator.
Apply the frozen fold policy to fold k with prefix-only signal access; pool held-out decisions over all 322 tasks.
A candidate is valid only with extractable code, a valid raw r and an official checker label; otherwise the policy abstains.
Arms: prior_only (raw r threshold), single gemini_flash, selected triple. Always-query Brier is a separate diagnostic.
Collection spend is reported separately from the counterfactual policy query cost.

settings.cost_fit: mean training-fold provider-token cost for each verifier, including returned malformed replies
settings.order_selection: maximize mean training-fold prior exact J0 across all 60 ordered triples; lexicographic ties
